reason: ModLens is primarily an image-processing vision bridge for text-only coding agents, converting pasted images into structured OCR, layout, and semantic evidence through configured vision engines.

summaries.zh: ModLens 将用户粘贴或提供的图片发送到配置的视觉引擎，并为纯文本编码代理返回结构化的 OCR、版面和语义证据。
summaries.en: ModLens sends user-pasted or supplied images to configured vision engines and returns structured OCR, layout, and semantic evidence for text-only coding agents.

capabilities: Reads pasted images or image paths supplied by the user
Sends image data to configured vision providers or reused agent CLIs
Extracts OCR, layout, semantic, entity, and relation information into structured evidence
Maintains context for later questions about a previously processed image
